summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Golden Pirates hero section role-aware features, sections pirate upgrade, and responsive design. All major functionality working correctly across visitor, recruit, and council roles.

minor_warnings.issue: React warning about fetchpriority vs fetchPriority DOM property
minor_warnings.impact: Console warnings only, no functional impact
minor_warnings.details: React expects fetchPriority (camelCase) instead of fetchpriority (lowercase) for DOM properties. This appears in multiple image tags.

passed_tests: ✅ HERO role-aware (visitor): Shows 'UN NAVIRE EN VUE…' welcome message with hero-cta-apply and hero-cta-track buttons
✅ HERO role-aware (recruit): Shows 'BON RETOUR À BORD, NAVTESTMOUSSE' with hero-cta-recruit-dossier and hero-cta-recruit-mer buttons
✅ HERO role-aware (council): Shows 'CAPITAINE SUR LE PONT…' with hero-cta-council-deck and hero-cta-council-messages buttons
✅ HERO ambience: Embers (data-testid=hero-embers), storm flash, waves, and compass (desktop) all render correctly
✅ HERO layout: No horizontal overflow, all content readable, buttons not covered
✅ Section dividers: divider-code, divider-recit, divider-process all visible between sections
✅ Manifesto cards: All three cards (fraternity, rigor, supremacy) have red wax seals
✅ Code articles: All 5 articles (code-article-1 to 5) have wax seal numerals
✅ Timeline: Ship icon (timeline-ship-here) visible at current step (Pré-KVK)
✅ Process step 4: Shows 'X MARQUE LE TRÉSOR' text with X icon, not overlapping
✅ FR/EN translation: Language switcher works, hero and sections translate correctly
✅ Apply form recruit banner: Shows code GP-1023-F6MG with apply-recruit-goto button to /suivi#dossier
✅ Apply form council banner: Shows apply-council-banner with apply-council-goto button to /admin#registry
✅ Application submission flow: Form submission → review panel → seal → success modal → tracking code → role change to recruit
✅ Navbar regression: Works correctly for all roles (visitor, recruit, council) on desktop and mobile
✅ Mobile menu drawer: Opens/closes correctly, shows role card with correct role
✅ Gold buttons: Working on Suivi page, Donations page, and Admin login ('OUVRIR LE COFFRE')
✅ Responsive design: All viewports from 320px to 1920px work without horizontal overflow
✅ Responsive viewports tested: 320px (iPhone SE), 360px (Android), 375px (iPhone 6/7/8), 390px (iPhone 14), 412px (Pixel/Samsung), 768px (iPad), 1024px (iPad Pro), 1280px, 1440px, 1920px (Desktop)
✅ Prefers-reduced-motion: Page loads correctly without breaking
✅ Hero CTA button navigation: All role-specific buttons navigate to correct pages with correct hash fragments
✅ Console errors: No critical errors (only expected 401 on /api/auth/me for visitors)
